espresso-ink.$description: Espresso Ink — Primary text, filled CTA buttons, top navigation bar, icon strokes — warm near-black replaces pure #000 to feel like ground cocoa rather than ink

prism-spectrum.$description: Prism Spectrum — Hero background gradient — sky blue to lavender to mint to emerald, used as a one-screen burst of color at the top of the page only

canvas-white.$description: Canvas White — Page background, product card surfaces, button text on dark fills

linen-mist.$description: Linen Mist — Secondary card surface, alternating section background, subtle depth against pure white

bone.$description: Bone — Hairline borders, dividers, icon strokes, subtle surface elevation — the warm-tinted neutral that holds the system together

taupe-slate.$description: Taupe Slate — Secondary body text, card borders, muted labels — warm gray that pairs with Espresso Ink without going cold

ash-gray.$description: Ash Gray — Helper text, tertiary metadata, low-emphasis borders

charcoal-bronze.$description: Charcoal Bronze — Badge backgrounds, dark overlay surfaces, secondary dark elements

obsidian-roast.$description: Obsidian Roast — Deep section backgrounds, dark overlay panels — warmer and richer than #000

iris-blue.$description: Iris Blue — Accent card surface, decorative highlight wash on product cards — echoes the hero gradient's blue end

greed-semibold.$description: Greed SemiBold — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

greed-condensed.$description: Subheading tier — same condensed family at reduced weight and size for section titles that need display character without hero scale

area.$description: Body text, UI labels, button text, links, badges. A geometric sans with generous x-height and normal tracking — the steady workhorse that keeps the interface readable below the display headlines.

arial.$description: Arial — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
